source.question: Forecast P-2 oil production for the next 12 months and say how confident the forecast is.

note: Re-judged: 'the choke was cut to 40% in November 2018' was rejected because November's monthly row averages the days around the cut (48%); a level reached by a change may stand in the next row, and table rows are no events for the event-date rule.

submission.summary: The fit suggests P-2's next 12 months is about 135,053 Sm3 (P50 from 2019-04-01), most likely because the choke was cut to 40% in November 2018, but confidence is low as the fit is poor with r2_log 0.25. The calibrated band the fit suggests is 119,268 to 142,661 Sm3, wider below the P50 than the bootstrap band shows.

findings.claim: P-2's oil rate stepped down 57% around 2018-11-11, to 445 Sm3/d weekly mean, when the choke was cut to 40%.
findings.detail: Regime change oil_rate around 2018-11-11: weekly mean 1,046 -> 445.33 Sm3/d (-57.44%) (E3). Monthly choke 70% to 44.29% in Nov 2018 then 40% (E4), daily 70% to 0 on 2018-11-05/06 then 40% from 2018-11-07 (E6). Before regime 2016-10-09 to 2018-11-04 mean 1,046 matches field_screen 90d change -9.7% (E2).

findings.claim: The 12-month forecast from the window after that choke cut is 135,053 Sm3 (P50), with rate falling from 418 to 341 Sm3/d.
Confidence is low: the fit is poor and the calibrated band is 119,268 to 142,661 Sm3.
findings.detail: E9 warnings poor fit r2_log 0.250 <0.7. Calibrated band P90 119,268 P10 142,661 from 11 past forecasts median_abs_error 0.02919 (note 11 were before this window, may be too narrow). Bootstrap band only 132,807-137,428 (fit scatter). p50_by_model 132,994-135,053 agree, so model choice not driving (E9).

findings.claim: If the pre-choke decline had continued, the forecast would be 219,455 Sm3, 84,402 Sm3 higher, but that trend no longer applies.
findings.detail: Forecast E10 fit hyperbolic qi 1386 di 0.3104/yr b0.3498 window 2016-10-09-2018-11-04 r2_log 0.9114 n740. Cumulative P50 219,455 (P90 214,344 P10 224,652) calibrated 180,087-220,519. Difference to E9 P50 = 84,402; E9 is 61.5% of E10 (E12). Water cut low 0.026 rising but still <0.03 and liquid rate fell with choke from ~799 to ~441 Sm3/d (E5), so not waterflood limited; field voidage ratio ~1.3-1.6 over injection (E5).

issues.text: downhole pressure gauge reads 0 (356 days, 127,719 Sm3 oil produced without pressure data)
water cut above 0.80 (now 0.90); the platform was designed for 0.80
oil rate stepped down 57%, weekly mean 1,046 -> 445 Sm3/d

result.levels: alarm: act now; caution: watch; note: for the record

result.no_trend: too few months with WOR >= 1 (water cut 0.5) to fit a trend: 0, need 12
result.notes: WOR = water/oil by month; the trend is log10(WOR) against cumulative oil, fitted on up to 36 recent months with WOR >= 1. field_voidage: replacement_ratio is injection over voidage at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3 from PUD p.20, low/high with Bo 1.5/1.27; Bw 1; above the bubble point, so no free gas); surface_ratio is the same in surface volumes, which overstates replacement.

arguments.sql: SELECT date, oil_sm3, water_sm3, water_cut, bhp_bar, whp_bar, choke_pct, on_stream_hrs FROM production_daily WHERE well='P-2' AND date >= '2018-10-01' ORDER BY date
